details:
Our project consists of creating an interactive digital story featuring the exploration robots Spirit and Opportunity, who tell their own adventures, experiences, and discoveries during their missions on Mars. Through an interactive template designed in Canva, we aim to present their story in a dynamic, creative, and entertaining way, allowing readers to learn about the objectives of their missions, especially the search for water and their discoveries about the characteristics of Martian soil. To develop the content, we based our research on web resources, documents, and educational materials provided by NASA, which allowed us to collect reliable information and understand the scientific and historical importance of these two explorers.

The purpose of our project is to spark curiosity and encourage people of all ages to learn about space exploration, science, and technology, showing that knowledge can also be shared through interactive stories and visual experiences. We used Canva as our main tool to design the pages, organize the information, and incorporate illustrations and animated elements. We also used ChatGPT (artificial intelligence) as support during the creative process, especially to guide the creation and animation of the Spirit and Opportunity prototypes, recreating some of their movements and internal mechanisms. Additionally, to ensure that the information was accurate and reliable, we consulted educational resources, documents, archives, and official repositories provided by NASA. These served as the main sources for researching the missions, journeys, and discoveries of Spirit and Opportunity on Mars.Our creativity lies in transforming scientific information into a storytelling experience in which the robots become the main characters and narrators of their own history. In this way, we aim to make learning more accessible, engaging, interesting, and enjoyable for people of all ages.
